ruleset.name: nitpicker-test-honesty
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD rules for test sources.

rule.name: DisabledTest
rule.message: Fix or delete this test instead of disabling it.

rule.name: AssertionInControlFlow
rule.message: Assert unconditionally: an assertion in a branch, loop or iterating callback (forEach, map, filter) does not run when the branch is not taken or the collection is empty. Assert the whole collection at once, use a parameterized test (@ParameterizedTest) for a table of cases, or assertAll(() -> ..., () -> ...).
rule.description: An assertion that may not run proves nothing.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $controls := //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('Test', 'ParameterizedTest', 'RepeatedTest', 'TestFactory', 'TestTemplate')]] //(IfStatement | SwitchStatement | SwitchExpression | ForStatement | ForeachStatement | WhileStatement | DoStatement | ConditionalExpression | LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'mapToDouble', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'peek', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'takeWhile', 'dropWhile', 'reduce')]]) return $controls[not(ancestor::* intersect $controls)] [.//MethodCall[starts-with(@MethodName, 'assert') or @MethodName = 'verify']]

rule.name: TryCatchInTest
rule.message: Use assertThrows(Type.class, () -> call()) to expect an exception, and let unexpected ones fail the test.
rule.description: try/catch in a test hides failures or asserts nothing.

rule.name: TautologicalAssertion
rule.message: This assertion cannot fail. Assert the value the code under test produces.
rule.description: A constant assertion passes whatever the code does.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AlwaysFailingAssertion
rule.message: This assertion always fails. Call fail("reason") if the test must not get here, or assert the value the code produces.
rule.description: assertTrue(false) and assertFalse(true) are a disguised fail().

rule.name: MockedValueType
rule.message: Do not mock or spy a value type (String, number, date, Optional, record or a concrete collection). Construct a real instance. Mocking an interface such as List or Map is fine.
rule.description: A mocked value only tests the mock.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: TestOrderDependence
rule.message: Tests must not depend on order: give each test its own state, remove @Order and @FixMethodOrder, and use @TestMethodOrder only with MethodOrderer.Random.
rule.description: Order-dependent tests fail when run alone or in parallel.
